resolver_design.approach: Call-site-specific candidate dirs. world.gd already knows the category at each call, so no filesystem sniffing is needed. Keep _sheet() byte-for-byte; add NATIONS + nation_of() + _nation_sheet() and swap each call site.
resolver_design.gdscript:
const NATIONS := ["aus", "eng", "pol", "rus", "spa", "tur", "ukr", "bav", "den", "fra", "hun", "net", "pie", "por", "pru", "sax", "swe", "swi", "ven", "alg", "sco"]

func nation_of(name: String) -> String:
    # Accepts "rus_peasant_walk.png" or "rus_peasant_walk".
    # The '_' guard keeps generic "spakh_*" in common, not Spain.
    var stem := name.trim_suffix(".png")
    if stem.length() < 4 or stem[3] != "_":
        return ""
    var p := stem.substr(0, 3).to_lower()
    return p if NATIONS.has(p) else ""

# UNCHANGED: probe the given dirs in order, then the legacy base path.
func _sheet(base: String, name: String, dirs: Array) -> String:
    for d in dirs:
        var p := "%s/%s" % [d, name]
        if _res_exists(p):
            return p
    return "%s/%s" % [base, name]

func _nation_sheet(base: String, name: String, kind: String, legacy: Array) -> String:
    # kind = "units" | "buildings" | "naval".
    # Canonical root first (all baked art lives there), then 'base' if a
    # quality preset redirected _anim_dir(). Legacy chain appended verbatim.
    var nat := nation_of(name)
    var roots := ["res://assets/models/anim"]
    if base != "" and base != roots[0]:
        roots.append(base)
    var dirs: Array = []
    for root in roots:
        if nat != "":
            dirs.append("%s/%s/%s" % [root, nat, kind])
        dirs.append("%s/common/%s" % [root, kind])
    dirs.append_array(legacy)
    return _sheet(base, name, dirs)
